atomic_facts.fact: The SEC filed a lawsuit against NDB Inc.
The lawsuit names NDB's CEO Nima Golsharifi as a defendant alongside the company
The SEC alleges NDB and Golsharifi defrauded investors by making materially false and misleading statements
Nima Golsharifi is the Chief Executive Officer of NDB Inc.
Nima Golsharifi is a Founder of NDB Inc.
